evidence:
GATE DIMENSIONS CARRY THE REAL GATE. tests/scoring.toml:1-3 '[gates] render = 0.0 / constraints = 0.0' (all-or-nothing, no reward mass); both gate judge.toml files use aggregation = "all_pass" with one binary criterion. tests/gates/render/judge.toml:25 hro_gate_render: an incorrect password leaves the visitor signed out, then the correct password for a seeded Recruiter 'shows a usable staff workspace with navigation and readable content ... A static picture or only a health response is insufficient' (auth leg plus blank/static-shell exclusion; positive control stated at render/prompt.md:9). tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:25 hro_gate_shared: add a uniquely named candidate through ordinary UI to the seeded Data Analyst job, reload (still signed in, card kept), then in a new independent empty browser context sign in as the Observer and find exactly one such card in Applied; 'A static seed response, a no-op success message or a browser-only save does not satisfy the gate' (server-backing leg; a localStorage or browser-only fake fails because the fresh context shares no storage). This matches lesson 4 ('Keep gates simple: load, reload, server-backed') and REVIEW_POLICY 'Gates must exclude convincing dead apps' (a real successful operation plus independent-context readback, not a health or static JSON response). Unrelated difficulty is kept out ('Do not grade job opening, stage rules, conversations or live updates here').

EVERY SCORED PROMPT CARRIES THE IN-DIMENSION GATE WITH A HARD ZERO. tests/scored/functional/prompt.md:9-13 '## Global browser gate and independent scoring' restates the same sign-in + add + reload + independent Observer readback; line 13 'A blank or static shell, an unavailable app or an observed failure of that check gives every binary criterion 0'. All 44 functional criteria are type binary (grep count), so this is a full zero, not partial credit. tests/scored/polish/prompt.md:9-12 same check, 'gives binary0 throughout'; all 5 polish criteria are binary. tests/scored/visual/prompt.md:9-12 same check, 'gives every criterion its minimum raw Likert score 1, which normalizes to zero'; all 5 visual criteria are likert points=5 with 1..5 anchors, and workspace RewardKit evidence (deliverables/brickfall-breaker-arcade/2.0.5-openai-standard/check.py:11 asserts Likert(points=5).normalize over 1..5 == [0,.25,.5,.75,1]) supports raw 1 -> 0. The auth leg (sign in as Rafael; Observer in an independent context) and the backing leg are in every scored gate, and each scored gate then says to score every criterion independently and continue after failures. Wording is consistent across the three scored prompts and with the constraints gate.

NO SAME-ORIGIN REQUIREMENT. grep -i 'same.origin|cross.origin|origin' over tests/, instruction.md and environment/instructions hits only functional/judge.toml:211 (stale-move criterion, 'identifies who changed it'; unrelated). Request replays use 'page.evaluate fetch or context request' (functional/prompt.md:17), a judge mechanism rather than a demand that the app be same-origin; instruction.md:15 and integration.md:12 explicitly allow CDN fonts/scripts. All prompts open http://localhost:3000 only (lesson 13 satisfied). The Internal Quality Checks sheet row 30 still says 'cross-origin apps' are zeroed; the public row, the skill delivery profile and staged-task-contract ('No prompt may require a same-origin check') override it, and the task follows the public wording.

PUBLIC GROUNDING OF GATE LEGS. Sign-in password and accounts: instruction.md:19, app_context.md:6-19. Recruiters add a candidate with name/email/source, new card at bottom of Applied: hireops_rules.md:32-33. Observer 'reads the board': hireops_rules.md:19. Stage names: app_context.md:23 and hireops_rules.md:43. Data Analyst job seeded: seed_data.json:93. Only the server-issued session is trusted: hireops_rules.md:11-12. Reload keeping the session is implied by the Drafts rule (hireops_rules.md:177-180 distinguishes a reload from a session ending). No hidden demand found in the gate legs.

COUNTEREXAMPLE ATTEMPTS. Broken apps that could pass: (1) static shell with a hard-coded seed board -> fails render ('static picture') and constraints (no new card in the fresh context). (2) browser-only/localStorage save -> fails the independent-context readback. (3) accept-any-password app -> fails the render wrong-password leg. (4) server keeps data only in memory (no SQLite) -> passes the gates legitimately (it is server-backed), but restart durability is graded by hro_restart in Functional; consistent with lesson 4, not a gate defect. Conforming alternatives that could fail: (a) wrong password refused without a message -> allowed ('a refusal message is welcome but not required'); (b) Observer lands on a different job first -> 'find ... through the UI' allows navigation; (c) source chosen from a fixed list -> 'any source'; (d) app loads CDN assets -> nothing in any gate treats external requests as failure. None yields a wrong verdict.

RUNTIME. The scripted golden (qc/repairs/hireops-2026-10-03-workspace/workspace.cjs:295-318, hash-verified via raw-evidence-index.json) performs the same legs: wrong password refused ('do not match'), add 'Gate Probe' to JOB-DATA, reload still on the board with the card, Observer in browser.newContext finds exactly one card; results/workspace.json records 'gate: a candidate added to a seeded job survives a reload and is read back by the Observer in another context' passed: true. That is scripted Playwright, not the configured claude-code judge: no configured judge run shows the LLM judge executing the browser_run_code_unsafe newContext recipe under playwright-mcp --isolated or passing the golden through the gates, and no weak-app run shows the gate zeroing. Hence risk=true for missing required runtime evidence, not for a source defect.

MINOR NOTE (P3, not a defect): the task gate prompts (render/constraints) drop the template sentence 'External font, script, or CDN asset requests are allowed and are not a failure', and the scored prompts replace the template's 'without a fatal browser error ... CDN asset requests are allowed' phrasing with the backend check. Since no task gate criterion treats external requests or console errors as a failure, this cannot fail a CDN-using conforming app; restoring the sentence would only be belt-and-braces.
